items.source: Configures the Pageable to be used as fallback in case no PageableDefault can be found at the method parameter to be resolved.
items.translation: 配置 Pageable，以便在无法在待解析的方法参数中找到 PageableDefault 时将其作为后备选项使用。

items.source: Returns whether the given Pageable is the fallback one.
items.translation: 返回给定的Pageable是否为回退实例。

items.source: the parameter name to be used, never null or empty.
items.translation: 要使用的参数名称，不能为 null 或空。

items.source: If you set this to Pageable#unpaged(), be aware that your controller methods will get an unpaged instance handed into them in case no Pageable data can be found in the request.
items.translation: 如果您将此设置为 Pageable#unpaged()，请注意：如果请求中找不到 Pageable 数据，您的控制器方法将收到一个 unpaged 实例。

items.source: Parameters can be prefixed to disambiguate from other parameters in the request if necessary.
items.translation: 参数可以prefixed，以便在必要时将其与请求中的其他参数区分开来。

items.source: Returns the name of the request parameter to find the Pageable information in. Inspects the given MethodParameter for Qualifier present and prefixes the given source parameter name with it.
items.translation: 返回请求参数的名称，用于查找 Pageable 信息。检查给定的 MethodParameter 中是否存在 Qualifier，如果存在则将其作为前缀添加到源参数名称之前。

items.source: Configures the maximum page size to be accepted. This allows to put an upper boundary of the page size to prevent potential attacks trying to issue an OutOfMemoryError. Defaults to DEFAULT_MAX_PAGE_SIZE.
items.translation: 配置允许接受的最大页面大小。这可以设置页面大小的上限，以防止潜在的尝试抛出OutOfMemoryError的攻击。默认值为DEFAULT_MAX_PAGE_SIZE。

items.source: The delimiter to be used between the qualifier and the actual page number and size properties. Defaults to _. So a qualifier of foo will result in a page number parameter of foo_page.

items.source:
Configures a general prefix to be prepended to the page number and page size parameters. Useful to namespace the
property names used in case they are clashing with ones used by your application. By default, no prefix is used.
items.translation: 配置一个通用前缀，将其附加到页码和每页大小参数之前。此功能可用于命名空间化属性名称，以防与应用程序中使用的名称发生冲突。默认情况下不使用前缀。

items.source:
Configures whether to expose and assume 1-based page number indexes in the request parameters. Defaults to
false, meaning a page number of 0 in the request equals the first page. If this is set to
true, a page number of 1 in the request will be considered the first page.
items.translation: 配置是否在请求参数中暴露并采用基于 1 的页码索引。默认为 false，表示请求中的页码 0 对应第一页。如果设置为 true，则请求中的页码 1 将被视为第一页。

items.source: Base class providing methods for handler method argument resolvers to create paging information from web requests and thus allows injecting Pageable instances into controller methods. Request properties to be parsed can be configured defaulting to page for the page number and size for the page size.
items.translation: 提供用于从 Web 请求创建分页信息的方法的基础类，从而允许将Pageable实例注入到控制器方法中。可解析的请求属性可以配置，默认情况下，页码属性为page，每页大小属性为size。
